about.title: The experience and credentials behind the project.
about.subtitle: Proven scale, licensed expertise and a strategic footprint backed by a mission to expand charging infrastructure.
cards: Since 2013, 1Solar has contracted with more than 20,000 customers and generated over $400 million in revenue during the past five years.
We are a preferred Tesla-certified installer. We are a fully licensed general contractor, and we hold master electrical and NABCEP credentials.
Locations in Utah, Nevada, and Colorado - our target Supercharger markets.
about.mission: Accelerating the EV revolution by owning and operating a network of Tesla Supercharger V4 stations, generating strong cash-flow returns for investors while expanding critical charging infrastructure across high-demand locations.

partnership.title: As a Tesla-certified installer, we can do one of two options.
partnership.subtitle: Choose either a host-lease structure or direct ownership; both create a convenient charging stop for guests.

optionOne.title: Add charging guests with $0 charger investment.
optionOne.subtitle: 1Solar funds, installs, owns and monitors the chargers. Kneaders provides eight stalls and receives lease income plus potential new restaurant revenue when charging drivers become Kneaders guests.

daily.title: Market data points to about $1,242 in daily charging revenue.
daily.subtitle: Based on nearby charging activity and the expected 92-session planning case, the station could leave about $340 per day in charging income after operating costs while bringing drivers on-site with time to order, dine or take food to go.

annual.title: About $124,100 in annual charging income could remain for Kneaders.
annual.subtitle: Kneaders owns the station and receives all available charging revenue. 1Solar stays economically aligned through per-session operations and support, creating shared accountability for utilization, reliability and long-term performance.

roi.title: Two revenue streams can support a compelling ownership case.
roi.subtitle: A $1.2 million station investment could create charging income for Kneaders while also bringing new guests on-site. The model keeps station income and potential restaurant sales separate so each source of value is easy to understand.

storeBreakdown.label: 7-Eleven Store #
storeBreakdown.description: Portfolio location identifier.
storeBreakdown.benefit: Keeps each candidate site tied to the correct portfolio record.

storeBreakdown.label: Store Address
storeBreakdown.description: Street address for the candidate site.
storeBreakdown.benefit: Identifies the property being evaluated.

storeBreakdown.label: City
storeBreakdown.description: City containing the candidate site.
storeBreakdown.benefit: Supports local market and utility context.

storeBreakdown.label: ZIP
storeBreakdown.description: ZIP code for the candidate site.
storeBreakdown.benefit: Supports geographic matching and regional data retrieval.

storeBreakdown.label: Utility
storeBreakdown.description: Electric utility serving the site.
storeBreakdown.benefit: Frames tariff, incentive, and interconnection conversations.

storeBreakdown.label: EVpin Score (1–5)
storeBreakdown.description: Third-party site-fit score on a five-point scale.
storeBreakdown.benefit: Provides an external screening signal for prioritizing sites.

storeBreakdown.label: GetEV Score (1–10)
storeBreakdown.description: Weighted GetEV site-fit score normalized to a ten-point scale.
storeBreakdown.benefit: Summarizes site fit in a sales-friendly score.

storeBreakdown.label: Ports
storeBreakdown.description: Number of proposed charging ports.
storeBreakdown.benefit: Sets station capacity and drives revenue and utilization calculations.

storeBreakdown.label: Ownership Option
storeBreakdown.description: Proposed ownership structure for the charging station.
storeBreakdown.benefit: Makes the buyer’s investment and revenue path explicit.

storeBreakdown.label: Estimated Project Cost
storeBreakdown.description: Estimated installed project cost before incentives.
storeBreakdown.benefit: Anchors financing, incentives, and payback discussions.

storeBreakdown.label: Lease / Port / Month
storeBreakdown.description: Monthly lease amount per charging port.
storeBreakdown.independentVariables: Lease Model recommended lease / port / month
storeBreakdown.benefit: Shows predictable host income under a lease structure.

storeBreakdown.label: Total Lease / Month
storeBreakdown.description: Ports × Lease / Port / Month.
storeBreakdown.independentVariables: Ports; lease per port per month
storeBreakdown.benefit: Converts a per-port offer into a monthly host-income figure.

storeBreakdown.label: Total Lease / Year
storeBreakdown.description: Total Lease / Month × 12.
storeBreakdown.benefit: Makes annual host income easy to compare with other property benefits.

storeBreakdown.label: Expected Utilization
storeBreakdown.description: Selected expected charging utilization case.
storeBreakdown.independentVariables: EVpin score; GetEV score; Tesla baseline; comparable adjustment
storeBreakdown.benefit: Connects market evidence to a transparent planning case.

storeBreakdown.label: Expected Visits / Day
storeBreakdown.description: Expected site sessions per day across all ports.
storeBreakdown.benefit: Translates utilization into a tangible daily demand estimate.

storeBreakdown.label: Avg kWh / Session
storeBreakdown.description: Average energy delivered in one charging session.
storeBreakdown.benefit: Drives charging revenue and utility-load estimates.

storeBreakdown.label: Charge Price / kWh
storeBreakdown.description: Customer charging price per kilowatt-hour.
storeBreakdown.benefit: Makes the charging-income assumption visible and reviewable.

storeBreakdown.label: Charging Income / Year
storeBreakdown.description: Annualized charging revenue after listed daily operating costs: (Charging Revenue / Day − Operating Costs / Day) × 365.
storeBreakdown.independentVariables: Visits per day; energy per session; charge price; operating costs; 365 days
storeBreakdown.benefit: Shows the station’s annual income contribution to the business case.

storeBreakdown.label: Avg Store Ticket
storeBreakdown.description: Average restaurant ticket for a captured charging guest.
storeBreakdown.benefit: Links charging dwell time to potential store sales.

storeBreakdown.label: Guest Capture
storeBreakdown.description: Share of charging visits that become restaurant guests.
storeBreakdown.benefit: Makes the conversion from chargers to customers explicit.

storeBreakdown.label: Store Sales / Year
storeBreakdown.description: Visits / Day × Avg Store Ticket × Guest Capture × 365.
storeBreakdown.independentVariables: Expected visits per day; average store ticket; guest capture; 365 days
storeBreakdown.benefit: Quantifies the potential restaurant-sales opportunity separately from charger income.

storeBreakdown.label: Combined Annual Value
storeBreakdown.description: Charging Income / Year + Store Sales / Year.
storeBreakdown.independentVariables: Charging income per year; store sales per year
storeBreakdown.benefit: Presents the total annual value stream for buyer review.

storeBreakdown.label: RMP Incentive Potential
storeBreakdown.description: Potential Rocky Mountain Power incentive amount, subject to eligibility and approval.
storeBreakdown.benefit: Helps identify utility support that could reduce project cost.

storeBreakdown.label: DEQ / Clean Air Incentive
storeBreakdown.description: Potential clean-air incentive amount, subject to program eligibility and approval.
storeBreakdown.benefit: Surfaces additional public or state support opportunities.

storeBreakdown.label: Total Incentives
storeBreakdown.description: RMP Incentive Potential + DEQ / Clean Air Incentive.
storeBreakdown.benefit: Shows the total modeled reduction before financing or tax review.

storeBreakdown.label: Net Project Cost
storeBreakdown.description: Project Cost − Total Incentives.
storeBreakdown.benefit: Provides the buyer-facing cost after modeled incentives.

storeBreakdown.label: Combined-Value Payback (Years)
storeBreakdown.description: Net Project Cost ÷ applicable annual value.
storeBreakdown.independentVariables: Net project cost; applicable annual value
storeBreakdown.benefit: Gives salespeople a simple time-to-value conversation starter.

scorecard.label: Charging Gap
scorecard.benefit: Highlights unmet charging need near the property.

scorecard.label: Road Audience
scorecard.benefit: Shows how many potential drivers can see or reach the site.

scorecard.label: EV Adoption
scorecard.benefit: Connects the proposal to the local EV market.

scorecard.label: Amenities
scorecard.benefit: Supports the argument that drivers have reasons to dwell nearby.

scorecard.label: Host Fit
scorecard.independentVariables: Site access, operating context, and host checklist
scorecard.benefit: Connects the data model to practical site execution.

scorecard.label: GetEV Score / 100
scorecard.description: SUMPRODUCT of the six scorecard components and their weights.
scorecard.independentVariables: Charging gap; road audience; EV adoption; amenities; corridor access; host fit; component weights
scorecard.benefit: Provides one comparable site-fit score for portfolio prioritization.

scorecard.label: Score Label
scorecard.description: Strong, Good, Conditional, or Weak based on score thresholds and critical flags.
scorecard.benefit: Turns a numeric score into an easy sales conversation.

utilization.label: EVpin / 5
utilization.description: EVpin site-fit score on its source five-point scale.
utilization.benefit: Keeps the external utilization input traceable.

utilization.label: Combined Site Score
utilization.benefit: Blends independent and internal site-fit signals.

utilization.label: Tesla Baseline
utilization.description: Baseline utilization assumption used in the model.
utilization.benefit: Makes the starting point for the forecast visible.

utilization.label: Comparable Adjustment
utilization.description: Capped adjustment from an observed comparable station versus the baseline.
utilization.benefit: Allows observed nearby performance to influence the forecast transparently.

utilization.label: Expected Utilization
utilization.description: Capped expected case from baseline, combined site score, and comparable adjustment.
utilization.independentVariables: Tesla baseline; combined site score; comparable adjustment
utilization.benefit: Creates an auditable expected planning case.

utilization.label: Conservative Utilization
utilization.description: Expected utilization less five percentage points, floored at ten percent.
utilization.benefit: Provides a downside case for buyer and lender discussions.

utilization.label: High Utilization
utilization.description: Expected utilization plus five percentage points, capped at thirty percent.
utilization.benefit: Provides an upside case without hiding the cap.

utilization.label: Expected Visits / Day
utilization.benefit: Converts utilization into expected daily station activity.

utilization.label: Conservative Visits / Day
utilization.benefit: Shows the lower-bound daily demand case.

utilization.label: High Visits / Day
utilization.benefit: Shows the upper-bound daily demand case.

financing.label: Loan Amount
financing.description: Financed project amount used in the Sunstone model.
financing.benefit: Shows the debt sizing assumption behind the ownership case.

financing.label: Monthly Payment
financing.description: Monthly loan payment for the modeled financing amount.

financing.label: Yearly Loan Payment
financing.benefit: Lets buyers compare debt service to annual value.

financing.label: Combined Value After Loan Payment / Year
financing.description: Combined annual value − yearly loan payment.
financing.independentVariables: Combined annual value; yearly loan payment
financing.benefit: Shows modeled value remaining after debt service.

financing.label: Combined Value After Loan Payment / Month
financing.description: Combined monthly value − monthly loan payment.
financing.independentVariables: Combined monthly value; monthly loan payment
financing.benefit: Makes the financing case concrete in monthly terms.

lease.label: Target Return
lease.description: Target annual return used to calculate lease capacity.
lease.benefit: Shows the return hurdle behind the host lease recommendation.

lease.label: Required Return / Year
lease.benefit: Makes the economics required by the owner explicit.

lease.label: Annual Lease Capacity
lease.description: MAX(0, Charging Income / Year − Required Return / Year).
lease.benefit: Shows how much host lease value the station can support.

lease.label: Calculated Lease / Port / Month
lease.benefit: Translates station economics into a per-port lease figure.

lease.label: Recommended Lease / Port / Month
lease.description: Rounded commercial lease offer per port per month.
lease.benefit: Gives salespeople a practical host offer to discuss.

lease.label: Post-Lease Cash Flow
lease.benefit: Shows the owner’s modeled cash flow after the lease.

lease.label: Post-Lease Return
lease.description: Post-Lease Cash Flow ÷ Gross Project Cost.
lease.independentVariables: Post-lease cash flow; gross project cost
lease.benefit: Confirms whether the lease structure preserves the target return.

fieldGuide.label: Operating Costs / Day
fieldGuide.description: Daily Tesla fee, utility cost, 1Solar support, and processing costs.
fieldGuide.independentVariables: Network fee; utility cost; support; processing
fieldGuide.benefit: Separates station operating costs from restaurant sales.

fieldGuide.label: Proposal / LOI Status
fieldGuide.description: Workflow status used to track portfolio progress.
fieldGuide.benefit: Helps sales teams prioritize follow-up and next actions.

fieldGuide.label: RMP / DEQ Incentives
fieldGuide.description: Potential or approved incentive amounts with eligibility status clarified in notes.

fieldGuide.label: Evidence Status
fieldGuide.description: Status of the supporting evidence behind a site-fit metric.
fieldGuide.source: 7-Eleven Charging Portfolio.xlsx · Field Guide and GetEV Scorecard
fieldGuide.benefit: Helps salespeople distinguish verified evidence from preliminary planning inputs.

fields.label: Monthly Value
fields.description: Combined Annual Value ÷ 12.
fields.benefit: Provides a monthly value view for property-owner conversations.

fields.label: Decision Note
fields.description: Short explanation of the modeled lease or site decision.
fields.benefit: Keeps the recommended action understandable to a salesperson and buyer.

fields.label: Critical Red Flag
fields.description: Site-level flag requiring exception review.
fields.benefit: Prevents a high score from hiding an execution blocker.

fields.label: Evidence Notes
fields.description: Supporting notes for the site-fit scorecard.
fields.independentVariables: Charging inventory; roadway counts; amenities; access; local demand
fields.benefit: Gives salespeople concise support for each score.

fields.label: EVpin / 100
fields.description: EVpin / 5 converted to a 100-point scale: EVpin × 20.
fields.benefit: Makes the external score comparable with GetEV’s 100-point score.

fields.label: GetEV / 100
fields.description: GetEV score on a 100-point scale.
fields.benefit: Carries the site-fit score into utilization forecasting.

fields.label: Tesla Comparable
fields.description: Observed comparable-station utilization input when available.
fields.benefit: Anchors projections to nearby real-world performance.

fields.label: Session Min
fields.description: Average charging-session duration in minutes.
fields.benefit: Converts utilization and ports into visits per day.

fields.label: Utilization Model Ports
fields.description: Ports used by the utilization model.
fields.benefit: Keeps forecast capacity aligned with the proposed station.

fields.label: Financed Project Cost
fields.description: Project cost used to scale financing payments by site.
fields.benefit: Shows the amount being financed for each candidate site.

fields.label: Financed Charging Income / Year
fields.description: Charging income carried from the portfolio model into financing.
fields.benefit: Compares charger income with annual debt service.

fields.label: Estimated Store Sales / Year
fields.description: Store sales carried from captured charging guests into financing.
fields.benefit: Keeps guest revenue visible in the financing view.

fields.label: Combined Monthly Value
fields.description: Combined Annual Value ÷ 12.
fields.benefit: Compares monthly value to monthly debt service.

fields.label: Lease Model EVpin
fields.description: EVpin score carried into the lease model.
fields.benefit: Keeps the commercial offer tied to site-fit evidence.

fields.label: Lease Model GetEV
fields.description: GetEV score carried into the lease model.
fields.benefit: Makes the recommended lease traceable to the site score.

fields.label: Lease Model Expected Utilization
fields.description: Expected utilization carried into lease economics.
fields.benefit: Connects station performance assumptions to host economics.

fields.label: Gross Project Cost
fields.description: Installed project cost before incentives.
fields.benefit: Shows the capital base used to calculate return.

fields.label: Lease Model Charging Income / Year
fields.description: Charging income used in lease capacity.
fields.benefit: Shows the revenue supporting the host lease.

fields.label: Recommended Lease / Year
fields.description: Recommended Lease / Port / Month × Ports × 12.
fields.independentVariables: Recommended lease per port; ports; 12 months
fields.benefit: Shows annual host income in the commercial proposal.

fields.label: Portfolio Evidence
fields.description: Short evidence note attached to a candidate site.
fields.source: 7-Eleven Charging Portfolio.xlsx · Store breakdown and GetEV Scorecard
fields.benefit: Lets the sales team explain why a site is worth pursuing.
